# `/managed-cluster-types` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /managed-cluster-types/v1

`getManagedClusterTypesV1` — List managed cluster types

Get a list of Managed Cluster Types.

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-types:manage, idn:managed-cluster-types:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `type` (query) — Type descriptor
  - `pod` (query) — Pinned pod (or default)
  - `org` (query) — Pinned org (or default)
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
- Returns 200: array of managedclustertype

### POST /managed-cluster-types/v1

`createManagedClusterTypeV1` — Create new managed cluster type

Create a new Managed Cluster Type. The API returns a result that includes the Managed Cluster Type ID

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-types:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): managedclustertype
- Returns 200: managedclustertype

### GET /managed-cluster-types/v1/{id}

`getManagedClusterTypeV1` — Get a managed cluster type

Get a Managed Cluster Type.

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-types:manage, idn:managed-cluster-types:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Managed Cluster Type ID
- Returns 200: managedclustertype

### PATCH /managed-cluster-types/v1/{id}

`updateManagedClusterTypeV1` — Update a managed cluster type

Update an existing Managed Cluster Type.

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-types:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Managed Cluster Type ID
- Body (application/json-patch+json): jsonpatch
- Returns 200: managedclustertype

### DELETE /managed-cluster-types/v1/{id}

`deleteManagedClusterTypeV1` — Delete a managed cluster type

Delete an existing Managed Cluster Type.

- Scopes: idn:managed-cluster-types:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The Managed Cluster Type ID
- Returns 204: no body
